description: Astronomers have created the sharpest map yet of dark matter using deep observations from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope. By analysing the gravitational distortion of hundreds of thousands of distant galaxies, the team traced invisible dark matter across a large region of the sky. The results confirm that dark matter forms the scaffolding around which galaxies and galaxy clusters grow.
title: James Webb Helps Astronomers Chart the Universe’s Hidden Dark Matter

title: Amazon to Reportedly Layoff 16,000 Employees, India Might Be Among Worst-Hit Regions

description: You can easily keep track of your Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) account balance and transaction history through your EPFO passbook. While you can always visit a nearby EPFO seva kendra, it is not always the most feasible option. In such scenarios, downloading your EPFO passbook online is convinient way to get the information. You can download your EPFO passbook as a PDF using different methods online. You can visit the EPFO member portal, download the UMANG app, or use the government's SMS and missed call services.
title: EPFO Member Passbook: How to Download EPFO Member Passbook Online Using Different Methods

description: New observations from ESA’s Solar Orbiter show that solar flares can be triggered by cascading magnetic disturbances. During a close solar pass, the spacecraft captured fine details of twisted magnetic fields repeatedly breaking and reconnecting, creating a magnetic “avalanche” that amplified a small instability into a powerful flare. The findings offer new insight into how the Sun releases vast amounts of energy.
title: ESA’s Solar Orbiter Reveals How Magnetic Avalanches Trigger Solar Flares

Plaintiffs claimed Google secretly captured and shared private conversations when the assistant was unintentionally activated, enabling targeted advertising.
title: Google Settles Google Assistant Privacy Lawsuit for $68 Million
